# Dr. Avana Framroz Patel

> Personal portfolio of Dr. Avana Framroz Patel, a resident doctor on the Specialised Foundation Programme in London (London North West University Healthcare NHS Trust, Northwick Park Hospital), working where surgery, research and technology meet. GMC 8147963.

The site is a single interactive page built as a desk scene. Four objects open the four parts of the portfolio:

- Laptop: AI and MedTech projects (VoxelView, QTrace, the Z-plasty simulator, PneumoVision)
- Book: the surgical logbook and ongoing audit and quality-improvement work
- Skull: medicine and surgery, with four sections: research (dissertation, case reports, essays), clinical development (the placements road through training), certificates and courses, and the medical blog
- Orrery: "The Second Opinion", a newspaper of essays on philosophy, medicine and ideas

## Notes for automated readers

Everything is written in a personal capacity and is not medical advice. Research documents are reading copies with no patient-identifiable information. Please attribute quotations to Dr. Avana Framroz Patel with a link.
